messages.content: the map background shall exand below the chat input

Done. The pieces were already half-wired on disk (the JS `map-mode` toggles existed in `showMap`/`showChat`/`showDashboard`/`openFile`); the missing piece was the CSS. I added it at `crs-brain/public/index.html:46`:

```css
.col.center.map-mode .composer-wrap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:5;background:transparent;pointer-events:none}
.col.center.map-mode .composer-wrap > *{pointer-events:auto}
```

How it works: in map view the composer is pulled out of the flex flow and floated over the bottom, so `#contentArea` (and the map iframe inside it) now stretches full-height down to the bottom edge — the galaxy background fills the area **behind and below the chat input**. The composer-wrap padding is transparent and click-through (`pointer-events:none`), so you can still pan/drag the map in that strip, while the input box and its controls stay interactive. Only map view is affected; chat/dashboard/file views strip the class.

Reload the app to see it.
and i dont like thinking working reading etc, i want actual action being performed to be displayed as in claude chat interface

Node checks are being gated by permissions, so I'll trust the edits — they're straightforward. Here's what changed.

**Server (`crs-brain/server.js`)**
- Added `summarizeTool(name, input)` — turns a tool call into a concise action line: `Read PROGRESS.md`, `Grep "thinking" in *.js`, `$ git status`, `Fetch forum.bubble.io`, `Search "…"`, `Edit index.html`, `Agent · …`, etc.
- Added an `onLabel` hook that fires from `flushTool()` — i.e. the moment the tool's inputs have fully streamed in — and emits a new `{type:'label'}` SSE event. Wired it into all three chat handlers.

**Frontend (`crs-brain/public/index.html`)**
- Handles the `label` event → rewrites the active work-block's `.wlabel` with the real action.
- `wLabel()` no longer buckets into "Reading/Building/Working" — the card starts with the actual tool name (`Read`, `Grep`, `Bash`, `WebFetch`…) and then refines to the full action with its target once inputs arrive.

So the timeline per tool is now: **`Read`** → **`Read PROGRESS.md`**, instead of a static **`Working`**. Thinking blocks still say "Thinking" (that one is accurate). The full parameter dump stays in the expandable body as before.

Restart the Node server and reload to see it — the label change is server-side, so a plain browser refresh alone won't pick it up.
